The Royal Alderaanian [[House Cortess]] owned an estate in the [[Kaamos Territory]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], also referred to as '''House Cortess'''. It was the seat of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Peyar Cortess]] and his wife [[Chay Cortess]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Perovius]] commanded the defenses of the estate around [[3643 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the Dark Side option in the [[Imperial Agent]] storyline the estate is turned into the nesting grounds for [[Oroboro]] [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]. In the Light Side option, Peyar Cortess and most of his house are spared.
